### Logic AU debugging rule (2026-07-11)
Do not make "lazy" moves here. Progress means deterministic evidence, not shortcuts:
- no blind rebuild/reinstall loops
- no cache wiping unless paired with a clean registration/validation plan
- no aborting scans if it prevents Contrapunk from being registered
- no patching Svelte, AU wrapper, or CLAP wrapper until the exact failing layer is proven
- every step must end with one observable fact: installed hash, codesign state, cache/scan state, real UI request path, crash report attribution, or Logic UI screenshot

Current known facts:
- signed `/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/Contrapunk.component` has matched the intended signed build during installer verification
- Contrapunk's AU wrapper contains CocoaUI and parent-deferral symbols
- Contrapunk's embedded CLAP contains Svelte assets and the debug `Not Found: path=... uri=...` response
- earlier `Not Found` proved the real webview could open; current generic sliders mean Logic is falling back to its parameter editor / stale or incomplete AU registration
- the 13:13 crash was Auto-Tune+Time_AU, not Contrapunk

Next progress step: establish a clean Contrapunk AU registration/custom-editor state, then open a fresh Contrapunk AU instance and capture either the Svelte UI or the exact debug `Not Found: path=... uri=...` request.

### REAPER x86_64 plugin UI validation (2026-07-11)
- Watcher alert at check 132/144: Logic not running, no new crash in the latest process output.
- REAPER first loaded x86_64 CLAP but showed `Not Found: path="/index.html" uri="contrapunk://localhost/"`.
- Root cause was `CONTRAPUNK_PLUGIN_UI_DIR=ui/build` resolving relative to `plugin/`, producing an empty generated asset map.
- Patched `plugin/build.rs` to resolve relative UI dirs against the workspace and fail `embed-ui` builds when the UI dir is missing/empty.
- Rebuilt x86_64 CLAP/VST3 with embedded assets, installed hash `3db9159e256bae32e481b7be0d37cbc807cfd5cfeff15482d40cb30fbcd18f77` to user CLAP/VST3 paths.
- REAPER reopened fresh CLAP and displayed the real Svelte/WebView UI (Contrapunk Harmony panel), no crash.

### Logic 12-hour watcher completed (2026-07-11)
- `contrapunk-logic-12h-watch` (`proc_3`) completed successfully after 144/144 checks.
- Run window: `Sat Jul 11 03:47:05 IST 2026` → `Sat Jul 11 15:47:52 IST 2026`.
- Final check: `check 144/144 logic_pid=46027 window=unknown`.
- No `NEW_CRASH` after the previously inspected `14:07:44` Auto-Tune+Time_AU crash.

### AU UI research/local evidence (2026-07-11)
- Apple AUv2 custom UI path is `kAudioUnitProperty_CocoaUI` → `AUCocoaUIBase` → `uiViewForAudioUnit:withSize:` returning an `NSView`; hosts show generic controls when no usable custom view is available.
- Public reports match our symptom class: `Cocoa Views Available: 0` / Logic not loading UI, wrapper class/bundle collisions, and AUHostingServiceXPC hosting crashes.
- Local current system AU wrapper advertises Cocoa UI symbols, but its nested `/Library/.../Contrapunk.component/.../Contrapunk.clap` does not contain `_app/immutable` or `Not Found: path=` markers, while the REAPER-fixed user CLAP does. Current Logic AU is therefore not yet the same embedded-asset build that REAPER validated.

# Phase 10.1: Guitar Reliability — Context

**Gathered:** 2026-07-11
**Status:** Complete — automated gates passed; manual release smoke is tracked separately

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

Improve the existing shipping guitar pipeline as far as the checked-in 138-file labeled corpus supports. The product claim is limited to clean, monophonic, standard-tuned six-string guitar. This phase does not add polyphonic detection, chord/double-stop support, alternate tunings, bass, extended-range instruments, or broad microphone claims.
</domain>

<decisions>
## Locked Decisions

- Evaluate the actual `GuitarInput` used by the product, not a separate research detector.
- Keep a fixed development/holdout split; tune only against development and report holdout separately.
- Corpus gates certify this corpus only, not guitar input in general.
- Required gates: >=95% exact first-note accuracy, <5% isolated recordings with false retriggers, 100% matching NoteOff cleanup, deterministic repeated output, no crashes/stuck notes, and faster-than-real-time processing.
- Fix confirmed correctness defects before threshold tuning.
- Tauri's cpal callback may deinterleave and enqueue only; `GuitarInput` belongs to a worker.
- Calibration language must match behavior. Use **Tune Guitar** until persisted measurements genuinely calibrate the detector.
- Preserve guitar input on Tauri, WASM/browser, and plugin surfaces; do not claim ordinary Logic guitar-track input while the AU remains an `aumi` MIDI processor.
- Do not stage or alter unrelated Elixir/Golem work.
</decisions>

<specifics>
## Known Evidence

- Corpus: `ui/static/samples/by_class/`, 138 mono 48 kHz 16-bit WAV files, one per string/fret label.
- Audited baseline: 16/138 exact first detections, 32/138 eventual correct detections, 85.5% files with multiple NoteOns.
- Confirmed defects: first-note octave correction lacks history; legato reads its previous cents after pushing the current value; vibrato uses analysis-window duration instead of hop duration; core emits two representations of each bend; structural config changes can replace `buffer_size` without rebuilding buffers; Tauri callback allocates and locks while running DSP.
- Calibration is split between `GuitarCalibrationProfile` and `GuitarCalibration`; the persisted profile only partially influences DSP.
</specifics>

<deferred>
## Deferred

- Chords, double-stops, polyphony.
- Alternate tunings, bass, seven/eight-string instruments.
- Broad acoustic/microphone/noisy-room claims.
- Heavy browser DSP migration to AudioWorklet WASM execution.
- Logic AU audio input until the wrapper is registered and validated as an audio effect/instrument with input.
</deferred>

# Phase 10.1 Plan 01: Guitar Reliability — Completion Summary

**Status:** Automated acceptance complete; manual hardware/release smoke remains
**Updated:** 2026-07-19
**Certified scope:** Clean, monophonic, standard-tuned six-string guitar notes represented by the checked-in corpus

## Delivered

- Added a permanent deterministic evaluator for all 138 by-class WAV fixtures with a fixed 108-development/30-holdout split.
- Locked gates for exact first note, retriggers, matching NoteOff cleanup, deterministic event streams, faster-than-realtime processing, and first-correct onset-relative p95 <=120 ms.
- Corrected detector attack/decay, legato voting, bend lifecycle, cleanup ordering, structural reconfiguration, Tauri worker publication/overflow/calibration behavior, and browser capture lifecycle/config forwarding.
- Kept allocating guitar DSP off the Tauri cpal callback behind a bounded queue and worker-owned `GuitarInput`.
- Unified public terminology around **Tune Guitar** and preserved the narrow clean-monophonic claim.
- Fixed `examples/guitar_capture.rs` so the callback appends its triggering 2,048-sample block once; added a regression using distinct first and second blocks.

## Corpus repair and freeze

The original capture utility duplicated its first 2,048-sample block. All 1,380 source plucks contained that exact defect. `ml/training/export_samples.py` now applies one independently auditable policy:

1. Remove the duplicate only when the first two 2,048-sample blocks are byte-identical.
2. Resample actual audio to 48 kHz before writing the 48 kHz header.
3. Find three consecutive offline YIN frames within 0.75 semitone of the annotated string/fret pitch; use the end of the complete three-frame evidence run.
4. Rank eligible source plucks by expected-period autocorrelation minus spectral flatness, with source order as the only tie-breaker.
5. Retain 10 ms pre-roll and one 250 ms note, apply a 5 ms fade, pad to 500 ms, and gain-normalize to 0.8 peak without clipping.
6. Freeze reproducible onset provenance as the first 128-sample frame reaching 10% of that fixture's peak frame RMS.

Curation does not consult capture-time detector validation/confidence/peak/RMS, Contrapunk runtime output, filename exceptions, or holdout membership. Two isolated regenerations were byte-identical and matched the checked-in 138 by-class, 18 showcase, 10 confused-pair WAVs, onset TSV, and manifest.

A fresh anonymous 24-fixture waveform/CQT audit classified 24/24 as valid immediate clean isolated notes, with no delayed noise, multiple/changing events, or visible clipping. The audit was blind to filenames, labels, detector output, and prior results. This validates the uniform policy sample; it is not a claim of broad microphone, guitar, tuning, or polyphonic generalization.

## Frozen evaluation evidence

| Partition | Exact first | Retrigger files | Clean release | Deterministic | Processing / realtime | First-correct p50 / p95 | Misses |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Development | 107/108 (99.1%) | 0/108 (0.0%) | 108/108 | 108/108 | 0.034x | 48.0 / 58.7 ms | 1 |
| Sealed holdout, single frozen run | 30/30 (100.0%) | 0/30 (0.0%) | 30/30 | 30/30 | 0.034x | 48.0 / 58.7 ms | 0 |

The holdout membership remained byte-identical (`c65c9401dd44006888db31763749a910117eb49aeb741bd93af659a235be4494`). The holdout test is ignored by default and was run explicitly only after development, fixture QA, regeneration determinism, and two independent policy reviews returned GO.

## Validation

- `cargo test -p contrapunk-audio --lib` — 225 passed.
- `cargo test --example guitar_capture capture_triggering_frame_is_appended_once` — 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p contrapunk-audio --test guitar_corpus_acceptance development_corpus_gate --release -- --nocapture` — development gate passed.
- `cargo test -p contrapunk-audio --test guitar_corpus_acceptance sealed_holdout_corpus_gate --release -- --ignored --nocapture` — single frozen holdout gate passed.
- Corpus format audit — 138/138 by-class fixtures are mono PCM16, 48 kHz, 24,000 samples; all matched the blind-audited generated candidate.
- Regeneration audit — byte-identical across isolated runs and to the checked-in sample tree/onset provenance.
- `git diff --check` — passed for the focused Phase 10.1 corpus slice.
- Earlier recovery validation remains applicable: 225 core tests, Tauri bridge/calibration tests, WASM check, plugin tests, browser lifecycle serialization, and UI check with 0 errors.

## Remaining release acceptance

Automated Phase 10.1 gates are complete. Before the release claim is promoted beyond the corpus boundary, perform user-operated hardware smoke tests across supported sample rates/block sizes, device loss/restart, standalone/Tauri, browser, and DAW surfaces. Polyphony, chords, double-stops, alternate tunings, bass, extended-range instruments, noisy rooms, broad microphones, and broad guitar generalization remain out of scope.
